source.edition: Part I: 2026 (digital release c. mid-April 2026; ISBN 9789357296038); Part II: first edition August 2026 (online late September 2026)

review.by: OpenPath curriculum inventory (research from official and secondary sources; not an educator review)
review.note: Built from content/learning/syllabus/cbse-g09.json. 6 of 14 chapter titles could not be checked against an official source (marked sourceVerified: false). Each outcome was mapped to competencies by the inventory; outcomes were placed in sections by shared title words. Sources: https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/CurriculumMain27/SecPart1/Maths_SecP1IX_2026-27.pdf https://cbseacademic.nic.in/web_material/Circulars/2026/14_Circular_2026.pdf https://cbseacademic.nic.in/curriculum_2027.html https://ncert.nic.in/pdf/announcement/notices/NCERT_Press_Release_grade9.pdf. Notes: TEXTBOOK: For 2026-27 CBSE Class IX moved to the NCF-SE 2023 scheme. NCERT's new book is 'Ganita Manjari' (Part I, chapters 1-8, digital release about mid-April 2026; Part II, chapters 9-14, first edition August 2026, posted on ncert.nic.in at the end of September 2026). The old rationalised 'Mathematics: Textbook for Class IX' is no longer the book. The CBSE curriculum still writes 'Mathematics - Textbook for class IX, NCERT' generically (it was published 2 April 2026, before Part II existed). VERIFICATION: ncert.nic.in textbook pages and PDFs (iemh101-108, iemh201-206) are blocked to the fetch tool (robots), so I could not open the book itself. Part I chapter titles are verified from official NCERT sources (CIET audio-book page; NCERT library record for the book title). Part II chapter titles 9-14 come only from secondary sites (learnify.bh, extramarks, teachoo, odinnclasses, tiwariacademy), which all agree; marked verified:false. TITLE WORDING: the CIET listing gives the Part I titles from audio file names, so its punctuation is unreliable. For Ch 5, the printed form 'I'm Up and Down, and Round and Round' (with comma) follows extramarks and edzy. For Ch 8, sources disagree between 'Progressions' and 'Progression'; 'Progressions' is used, as in CIET and most sources.
